name: inv-8-sole-report-summary-constructor
description: A TestReportSummary, per-file results included, is minted only by parseReportSummary in engine/src/core/structured-test-report.ts, which runs reconcileFileResults before branding, and a counts-only ReportCounts only by parseReportCounts beside it. The report parsers, mergeSummaries and the ledger read-back (parseReportField in engine/src/machine/evidence.ts) all funnel through parseReportSummary, so per-file counts that disagree with the summary can never exist as a summary (G4 slice 2, FR-001, FR-003). This rule refuses a brand cast `as TestReportSummary` or `as ReportCounts` anywhere else.
fixHint: Construct a TestRun summary with parseReportSummary(total, failed, source, files), or counts alone with parseReportCounts(total, failed, source), from engine/src/core/structured-test-report.ts; each returns null when its invariant fails.
